title: Myrmidon's Immolation
html:
Myrmidon's Immolation is an action available to Fire Myrmidons, including in  Wild Shape: Fire Myrmidon form. It briefly  Hastens the myrmidon, granting an extra  Action.

Description

Ignite with incandescent, primordial flames that  Hasten you.

Properties

Cost
 Action
Details
 Range: Self
 Concentration
Duration: 3 turns

Technical details

UID
Shout_BurningRage_Myrmidon_Fire
Spell flags
IsConcentration, Wildshape

Condition: Hastened

 Hastened

Duration: 3 turns

  • Creature has a +2 bonus to  Armour Class,  Advantage on Dexterity  Saving Throws, its  Movement Speed increases by 9 m (30 ft),[See: Bugs] and it can take one additional  Action per turn.
  • When the condition ends, the creature becomes  Lethargic.

How to learn

Used by creatures: Fire Myrmidon

Notes

  • The extra action granted by this ability works with  Wild Strike and  Improved Wild Strike in Honour mode. This is unique because no other source of extra actions works with any form of  Extra Attack in Honour mode (other than  Action Surge).
  • While the condition is technically distinct from the normal  Hastened condition, it shares a stack ID and hence does not stack.
